basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: GTM Strategy Principal | Built AI GTM Systems for Enterprise Revenue | 3× Founder | MBA
basics.summary: MBA-trained senior operator who architects GTM systems and ships them. At LumApps I built the AI-driven revenue automation that Sales and RevOps depend on (2x conversions, $1M forecast quarterly) and report to C-level on outcomes. Prior 6 years co-owning cross-functional GTM launches at Beekeeper with Sales, PM and RevOps ($1.5M+ in revenue shipped, top platform channel). MBA (93.2%) at Quantic, Startup Mentor at Tenity advising 20+ founders per year on GTM readiness for VC decisions, and 3 AI products founded solo through Anand Creations. Deep bias for AI and automation as the step-change lever, and for turning complexity into narratives executives can act on.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Architected AI-driven revenue automation across Sales, RevOps and CS. Multi-agent workflows on Python + LangGraph unify Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, and product-usage signals into one auditable time-aware store (AI Brain). Step-change outcomes: 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities, 2 to 3 hours per rep per day, $1M forecast quarterly.
Lead the transition to AI-native GTM operating models. Cross-functional program spanning Product, Sales, RevOps and Finance; C-level executive updates that synthesise complex data into actions.
Own the governance and eval layer: safety cases, HITL gates, cost-per-request tracing, adoption metrics. Turned one-off wins into reusable patterns the rest of the org builds on.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.position: Senior Software Engineer (Technical Lead) & GTM Co-Owner
highlights: Co-owned cross-functional GTM launches with Sales, PM and RevOps: Seasonal Templates, Re-ignite Revenue, Sentiment Analysis, Employee Lifecycle. Every launch instrumented so we knew within a week if it moved the metric.

Architected the Employee Referral System end to end and ran its GTM. Became the platform's top revenue channel: $1.5M+ generated, $500K ARR. Owned coverage, segmentation, activation and post-launch expansion with Sales leadership.

Built GenAI demo tooling that auto-produced personalized content per account from Salesforce data. Direct sales enablement impact; the same personalization playbook translated into email and outbound.
Delivered exec-level readouts and strategic memos translating platform work into revenue impact. Trusted advisor to Product, Sales and RevOps stakeholders.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Technology Evaluation Panelist. Evaluated 20+ startups per year on architecture, scalability, forecast credibility, and GTM readiness for seed-to-VC investment decisions.
Trusted advisor to founders on GTM operating models, revenue motions, hiring specialists, and building governance frameworks that scale.

work.name: Obermatt
highlights: Bridged business and engineering on a financial-analytics product. Ran discovery with customers, built strategic roadmaps that lifted satisfaction and retention.
Directed a remote engineering team; introduced agile practices (productivity up 20%) and CI/CD (deployment times down 30%). Async-native operating.

Best angle: the JD explicitly wants AI/automation as step-change lever, which is my STRONGEST card. LumApps AI-driven revenue automation = literal proof; Beekeeper GTM co-ownership + $1.5M+ revenue; Tenity advisory to GTM leadership; Obermatt cross-functional TPM. Reframed LumApps position to 'Lead AI Engineer (GTM Automation)'. GAPS: no formal RevOps/Strategy Principal title, no strategy consulting background. Cover letter should sell 'MBA-engineer-turned-strategist who built the AI GTM system' angle. EMEA location matches (Zurich).
